notes: Twelve source and seventeen target tokens partitioned exactly once.
The ASV writes two the's for כָל־עוֹף הַשָּׁמַיִם, so the present article takes the one before its own word and the construct takes a supplied one (rule 29).
אַיִן carries there was no and heads on the negation under rule 50; the article on אָדָם is unrepresented, the ASV writing no man.
